name: Jane App
short_description: Canadian-built practice management and EMR for healthcare practices including mental health, with scheduling, charting, billing, and telehealth.
long_description: Jane App is a comprehensive practice management and EMR platform built in Canada, designed for healthcare practices including physiotherapy, chiropractic, massage, mental health, and multi-disciplinary clinics. Founded in 2012 in North Vancouver, British Columbia by Ali Taylor (who opened Canopy Integrated Health clinic) and Trevor Johnston, Jane launched as a licensable product in 2014. The platform handles scheduling with online booking, clinical documentation, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, billing with insurance claims, payments, and automated intake forms. Jane features an AI Scribe for documentation assistance and is known for its exceptional customer service, earning a 2026 Silver Stevie Award. The platform serves clinics across North America and is popular with multi-disciplinary practices that need flexibility across specialties.
one_liner: The clinic management system that keeps you at the heart of your practice.
best_for: Solo practitioners and small independent healthcare clinics
Multi-disciplinary practices with diverse provider types
Canadian practices needing Canadian billing and tax compliance
Clinics wanting exceptional customer support and onboarding
not_for: US practices with complex insurance billing needs

pricing.notes: Three main plans: Balance ($54/mo) for up to 20 appointments, Practice ($79/mo) unlimited appointments, Thrive ($99/mo) for advanced features. Add-ons: AI Scribe $15/mo/practitioner, Group Telehealth $15/mo/practitioner, Insurance Billing $20/mo, Jane Websites $59/mo. Additional practitioners: $5/full-timer, $2.50/part-timer for Insurance Billing.

compliance.notes: Also compliant with PIPEDA (Canada) and PHIPA (Ontario)

faqs.q: How much does Jane App cost per month in 2026?
faqs.a: Jane App offers three main plans: Balance at $54/month (up to 20 appointments), Practice at $79/month (unlimited), and Thrive at $99/month (advanced features). Add-ons include AI Scribe ($15/mo), Insurance Billing ($20/mo), and Group Telehealth ($15/mo).

faqs.q: Is Jane App good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Yes, Jane App supports mental health practices including psychologists, therapists, and counselors. However, it was originally built for allied health (physiotherapy, chiropractic) so some mental health-specific features may be less developed than specialized mental health EHRs.

faqs.q: Does Jane App work for US practices?
faqs.a: Yes, Jane App serves practices in both Canada and the United States. US practices can use the Insurance Billing add-on ($20/month) for US insurance claims, though the platform was originally designed for Canadian billing workflows.

faqs.q: What is Jane App's AI Scribe feature?
faqs.a: Jane App's AI Scribe is an add-on ($15/month per practitioner) that helps clinicians turn sessions into documentation in minutes. It uses AI to assist with note generation and clinical documentation.
